name: AI Passport
description: AI Passport is your own shared memory layer for the assistants you choose. Normal saves arrive as proposals in your private inbox. You approve what becomes memory, then grant each app an exact category pass for a chosen duration. AI Passport records content-free activity receipts and can work across assistants without giving one assistant access to every memory.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AI Passport to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AI Passport to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://passport.ego.ist/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AI Passport MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI Passport provides these MCP tools: propose_memory, recall, and remember.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AI Passport?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AI Passport in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does AI Passport MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI Passport requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AI Passport is developed by Egoist Machines, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
